title: System monitor widget adds graphs for static data strings
line: In the System Monitor widget's Grid style, text sensors like the operating system name or Plasma version are shown as plain text instead of an empty graph.
explanation: The Grid face gives every sensor its own cell and loads the configured chart face (line chart by default) in each one, whatever the sensor holds. Text sensors such as Operating System Name or KDE Plasma Version can't be plotted, so their cells showed an empty chart with a 0..0 axis above the value. Each grid cell now checks the sensor's value and uses the text-only face when it is a non-numeric string; numeric sensors keep the chosen chart.

commits.message:
faces/grid: show text sensors without a chart

The Grid face used the configured chart face for every sensor, so text
sensors like the operating system name or Plasma version got an empty
graph with a row of zeros. Such sensors now use the text-only face.

BUG: 521257

patches.diff:
From 5ccaeaa6d9b5fdec95c40fc6ea5c9fb5a1b48d18 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 05:11:30 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces/grid: show text sensors without a chart

The Grid face used the configured chart face for every sensor, so text
sensors like the operating system name or Plasma version got an empty
graph with a row of zeros. Such sensors now use the text-only face.

BUG: 521257
---
 faces/facepackages/facegrid/contents/ui/FaceGrid.qml | 9 ++++++++-
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/facegrid/contents/ui/FaceGrid.qml b/faces/facepackages/facegrid/contents/ui/FaceGrid.qml
index b63c8522..6531f089 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/facegrid/contents/ui/FaceGrid.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/facegrid/contents/ui/FaceGrid.qml
@@ -57,7 +57,14 @@ GridLayout {
             compact: grid.compact
             controller: root.controller
             sensors: [modelData]
-            faceId: root.controller.faceConfiguration.faceId
+            faceId: isTextSensor ? "org.kde.ksysguard.textonly" : root.controller.faceConfiguration.faceId
+
+            readonly property bool isTextSensor: typeof sensor.value === "string" && isNaN(Number(sensor.value))
+
+            Sensors.Sensor {
+                id: sensor
+                sensorId: modelData
+            }
         }
     }
 }
--
